en:
This here lets you breathe even when
you're underwater, see. With this, you
oughta be able to explore underwater
dungeons, too.

Vectreim x Tri-Layer Orat

en:
When you go into a cave, this shows
what's around you in a tiny window.
If you're confident you'll get lost,
you'd better make one.

Dvel Soft Steel x Frozen Elven Iron
note: Angel's Window. The 'confident you'll get lost' joke kept.

en:
This tells you how many stone blocks
there are on the floor. Once you know
how many impassable blocks there are,
won't mapping get a lot easier?

Dvel Soft Steel x Tri-Layer Orat
Vectreim x Mazurite
note: Rock Counter.

en:
This drives off the enemies lying in
wait beyond doors. Ring it once and
every enemy on the floor runs off...
but they drop treasure chests, so...

Frozen Elven Iron x Mazurite
Mazurite x Tri-Layer Orat
note: Dove Bell. Trailing-off regret kept: chasing them off loses their treasure chests.

en:
This calls back the enemies lying in
wait beyond doors. Ring it once and
every enemy on the floor comes back,
but fighting 'em all over again...

Dvel Soft Steel x Vectreim
Tri-Layer Orat x Milstone
note: Crow Bell. Mirrors 3868's structure, as the source does.

en:
This marks where enemies lie in wait
right on your map. It helps just by
carrying it, so make at least one.

Dvel Soft Steel x Mazurite
Frozen Elven Iron x Milstone
note: Sheep's Brush.

en:
...If your party's wiped out with this
on you, it gets hauled back to town.
What does? Your corpses, that's what.
Well, make one as insurance.

Dvel Soft Steel x Milstone
Frozen Elven Iron x Tri-Layer Orat
note: Bone Slippers. Source's subjectless 'is carried to town on its own' kept vague on purpose for the 'what? the corpses' punchline. 'on its own' ([JP]) compressed into 'gets hauled'.

en:
When you meet enemies, this tells you
their level. If the gap's too wide,
running's an option too, y'know? You're
still young. Don't rush to your death.

Vectreim x Milstone
note: Death Pinwheel.

en:
There are laws in this world, see,
that the likes of us can't fathom.
This shows 'em to you as numbers.
What they're like? Go see for
yourself, with your own eyes.

Mazurite x Milstone
note: Dice of Fate.

en:
The ultimate goal of alchemy -- this
is it. But it can't be made the usual
way. ...Let's see. Try a method
that's a bit on the dangerous side.
